thread:
customer_acero_cs: Hey team, heads-up: Acero production pool isn't scaling — seeing steady 429s and request queueing since ~09:10 UTC. Traffic ramped for a campaign.

support_engineer_devon: Can you paste a failing request example and confirm tenant config? min_replicas=2, max_replicas=20 for acero-prod?

customer_acero_cs: Example curl that failed:
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-acero..." -d '{"model":"gpt-j-6b","input":"hello"}' -> 429, body: {"error":"rate_limited","reason":"no_capacity"}

sre_maria: Pulling autoscaler logs now. Initial look shows scale attempts around 09:11 but node creation rejected with 403 billing error. Snippet:
[09:11:13] autoscaler: requested_scale delta=+4 pool=acero-prod
[09:11:14] orchestrator: create_node start
[09:11:16] k8s_api: pod create failed status=Forbidden reason=BillingAccountNotActive code=403
[09:11:16] autoscaler: scale_failed reason=billing_hold

oncall_ashley: Warm pool hit 0 at 09:09, min_replicas=2 were saturated. Autoscaler tried to add and got blocked. Queue depth rose quickly.

support_engineer_devon: So flow is: sudden marketing traffic -> cache miss & higher latency -> min replicas saturated -> warm pool empty -> autoscaler requested nodes -> upstream billing/auth failure -> no new capacity -> 429s. Correct?

sre_maria: Yes. We need fast mitigation: either fix billing hold, route traffic to spare capacity, or temporarily increase cached capacity if available.

support_engineer_devon: Can we reroute a portion to hosted shared pool in us-west-2? That should relieve queues quickly.

ops_bot: routing command accepted. route_id=r-9923 rollout=10% -> hosted-pool-usw2

customer_acero_cs: 10% reroute helped immediately — 429s down from ~42% to ~18% within 3 minutes.

billing_jared: Investigating billing provider: saw transient token renewal failures around 09:10 UTC; retries failed. Marking provider incident P2 and contacting provider.

support_engineer_devon: Collecting artifacts for postmortem: autoscaler logs (09:05-09:25), cluster events for acero-prod, warm_pool/min/max metrics, example request IDs/traces.

sre_maria: Suggested postmortem action items:
- autoscaler fallback: if node creation fails with billing/auth errors, optionally route traffic cross-tenant to shared pools (configurable safety fallback)
- more aggressive warm pool refill heuristics for tenants with known traffic patterns
- surface billing/provider error codes in Console alongside scale failure graphs
- add a smoke test simulating provider token rotation to validate fallback logic

support_engineer_devon: Repro steps for engineering to validate:
1) Run a load ramp: wrk -t8 -c200 -d60s --script=acero_ramp.lua https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
2) Observe metrics: autoscaler.scale_attempts, autoscaler.scale_failures, warm_pool_count
3) Inject a synthetic billing error on node create and confirm route-fallback triggers

oncall_ashley: Adding an alert: if warm_pool_count==0 AND queue_length>100 -> page SRE. Also note to create a dashboard tile correlating scale_failures with provider error codes.

billing_jared: Provider reports token rotation fixed, ETA 18 mins. Will update when resolved.

ops_bot: Provider token rotation cleared at 09:29:47 UTC. Autoscaler retried and new nodes reached Ready; pool returned to target by 09:36.

support_engineer_devon: Traffic normalized; post-fix 429s < 0.5%. Will compile postmortem and propose double-warmpool option for peak windows.

customer_acero_cs: Appreciate the quick mitigation. Please share the report and whether we can guarantee extra warm headroom for their scheduled campaigns.

support_engineer_devon: Will include options and SLA recommendations. Thanks all :thumbsup:
